This query treats the production quality data as a graph. In the MATCH pattern, (seed IS
entity) is the starting production order, -[e IS related_to]->(1,2} means follow one or two
relationship hops, and (reached IS entity) is every entity reached from that starting point.
The WHERE clause anchors the search on PO-8841, and the COLUMNS clause returns graph
properties in a normal SQL result table.
